blind.description: A stylized tribal wooden totem post anchored in a circular cluster of grey stones and moss. A horizontal crossbar near the top is bound with dark leather wraps. The front is decorated with a horned animal skull flanked by hanging feathers, and human skulls are mounted on either end of the crossbar. The wooden post features faint red paint markings. The mesh is solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures, with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: Resembles a horizontal bar capped with round skulls at both ends and upward-curving horns in the middle, sitting above a rounded cluster of grey base rocks.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: small mound of grey stones with green moss
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 feet tall (reaching roughly to the shoulder or chin of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the crossbeam.
